proof_attempt_summary: Discovery developed a matched fixed-grid n^-1/4 minimax-rate argument, a saturation-margin elbow, and exact C²-to-C¹,¹ support program claims. The D0.5 cold referee rated the package subfield below the required field floor, with paper-score ceiling 7.2 below 7.4 and no bounded in-scope improvement directive. The math panel requested revisions to exact feasibility, bank positioning, related work, and projection computation; those findings were not repaired, no Lean formalization began, and the claims are not certified sound.
tldr: A balanced six-cell pilot estimates its observed Bernoulli means at the parametric rate, yet globally minimax robust policy learning over exact capped smooth fibers has the sharp rate \(n^{-1/4}\). The square-root loss occurs at derivative-average saturation; the same projected learner obeys the matched elbow \(n^{-1/2}/\sqrt{\kappa+n^{-1/2}}\) for \(0\le\kappa\le\kappa_0\), where \(\kappa_0>0\) is selected by exact strict policy-score inequalities. Exact trace-preserving density and a finite closed convex velocity program make the learner computable. A quantitative local family has a uniform Gaussian observation limit and binary square-root-cusp loss, but equality of finite-experiment and Gaussian minimax values, transfer of an attaining rule, and the exact Gaussian-game optimizer remain open.
gap: New-treatment policy learning has a root-\(n\) theory under finite linear shape restrictions, while smooth interpolation theory characterizes curvature-optimal profiles without a statistical policy frontier. The inspected literature does not determine the global excess maximum-regret rate for exact capped \(C^2\) fibers.
fill: The project pairs a constructive support transfer and exact finite support representation with an explicit opposite-optimum testing pair, then separates the singular boundary from a checkable root-\(n\) regular region.
